text: Think of your finances like a household grocery budget where most items are routine but one expensive treat keeps blowing the plan. You have $93,000 of total debt and a single higher‑cost card for $18,000 at 18% that’s the costly item, while the rest (mortgage, student and vehicle) are at 6%, 5.5% and 4.5%. That means most of your debt is working quietly, and you and your partner can focus together on that one big expense to protect the family and keep momentum.
